script: Quick actions, and viewing person and employment information. Almost every HCM task starts the same way: open Our Workforce, pick a quick action, and search for the person. Before you change anything, read the Employment Info page, so you know the current assignment and recent history.
From the Oracle home page, open Our Workforce. It's Vanderbilt's name for Oracle's My Client Groups, and it holds the quick actions for people in your area.
Only a few quick actions show at first. Click Show More to see all of them, grouped by area, such as Employment. Which actions you see depends on your security role.

Open Employment Info and search for the person, by name or by person number. Person number is the safest way to avoid the wrong person with a similar name. Check the person type and status before you select.

Read the assignment details: business unit, department, job, position, location, manager, working hours, and assignment status. If the person has more than one assignment, make sure you're on the right one.
Review the history of changes. Click an entry to open View Employment Details, and see exactly what changed on that date.

Check for future-dated changes before you submit anything new. Oracle records are date effective, so a pending change, such as a transfer next month, can affect what you're about to submit. If you see one, coordinate before acting.
Two things to remember. Don't start a transaction until you've confirmed the right person and the right assignment. And a missing quick action usually means a security role issue, not a system error.
